comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
These gloves with +1 to mine laying/repair have a chance of dropping from a 9-star wreck in the Persian Gulf and seemingly nowhere else. Its Google translated name is "Wreck of the ruins investigation team"; perhaps some expert in shipwrecks could give the name used on Maris. In any case, now you know where to find them apart from bazaars/company shops. Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Salvaging/Data

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: It's called Excavators Shipwreck, a 9 star wreck they will usually spawn around Muscat (although they can appear anywhere in the Persian Gulf). There's also a 8 star one that appears in the East Mediterranean Sea (usually in the Nile River area), but they dont drop the gloves. I remember getting the Excavators SW a lot back in GAMA. With the new server and new SWs that have been added since then, however, Ive only gotten the Excavators wreck maybe two times out of the 200 wrecks ive pulled, making it a very rare appearance for me, although other players that have pulled considerably more then me may have had a different experience...

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: My personal record indicates that about 6% of the shipwrecks I raise is excavators shipwreck, although that is with 8 and 9 star ones combined. Considering the overall odds the chance of this item dropping sounds quite low, but it drops from time to time. I've at least sold 10 of these in Maris.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Thanks for the insights. It's been my observation that while shipwrecks may share names (it happens a lot as I recall), their star rating/sea region is what determines their potential loot table -- the JP wiki link seems to support that. So, only the Persian Gulf 9-star Excavators Shipwreck should have a chance of dropping these particular gloves.
